Download a Public Tutorial Dataset

Source: R/download_NICHESv2_data.R
download_NICHESv2_data.Rd

Downloads one of the two public datasets used in the website tutorials, checks its MD5 sum, and returns a count matrix and metadata ready for create_NICHESObject(). The files are attached to a release of the NICHESv2 GitHub repository, so no other package is needed. Each dataset is downloaded once and then read from cache.dir.

Usage

download_NICHESv2_data(
  dataset,
  cache.dir = tools::R_user_dir("NICHESv2", "cache"),
  force = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

dataset

"stxBrain" or "ifnb".

cache.dir

Folder to keep downloaded files in. Default: the NICHESv2 user cache folder, tools::R_user_dir("NICHESv2", "cache"). Delete the folder to free the space.

force

Download again even if the dataset is already cached. Default FALSE.

verbose

Print progress messages. Default TRUE.

Value

A list with count.mtx (a sparse genes x cells matrix of raw counts) and meta.data (a data frame with one row per cell), the same shape that extract_NICHESInputs_Seurat() returns. If the download fails, or the file doesn't match its MD5 sum, a message explains why and NULL is returned invisibly.

Datasets

"stxBrain"

10x Genomics Visium mouse brain, sagittal-anterior section 1: 2,696 spots and 31,053 genes, with spot coordinates in x and y. About 14 MB. CC BY 4.0, credit 10x Genomics.

"ifnb"

Human PBMCs, untreated or stimulated with interferon-beta (Kang et al., 2018): 13,999 cells and 14,053 genes, with the condition in stim and cell-type labels from the Satija Lab in seurat_annotations. About 11 MB. CC BY 4.0.

Each dataset's folder in cache.dir also holds a PROVENANCE.md file stating its source, license and the changes made.

References

Kang HM, Subramaniam M, Targ S, et al. (2018). Multiplexed droplet single-cell RNA-sequencing using natural genetic variation. Nature Biotechnology, 36(1), 89–94. doi:10.1038/nbt.4042

Examples

# \donttest{
# Downloads about 11 MB, kept in a temporary folder here.
inputs <- download_NICHESv2_data("ifnb", cache.dir = tempdir())
#> [download_NICHESv2_data] Downloading 'ifnb' (11 MB) ...
if (!is.null(inputs)) dim(inputs$count.mtx)
#> [1] 14053 13999
# }
